procedure: CHRO reviews both exact files and hashes; prior approval of 0b0a2326 does not cover either new file.

Submit each selected file separately through the formal Alpacon verified-file workflow with explicit purpose, 1-ubuntu target, confirmed existing operator account, exact file bytes/hash and command+webftp scope as needed for artifact staging. No permission/configuration changes. Do not use a different execution route or identity to bypass denial.
The script requires the new WorkSession UUID as its single argument. UUID syntax validation is not proof of active approval; Alpacon must enforce active session and file approval.

Run metadata-only proposal first only after its formal approval; inspect generic failure or exact identities. A successful result does not establish backups, recipient readiness or deployment readiness.

Only if separately approved, run the sensitive-read comparison proposal. No credential value is typed into script, command, environment override or tool arguments. Existing values stay in container/parent memory; transient proof travels only via captured child pipe.

On any denial, timeout, invalid flags/proofs, missing context, stopped/restarted/replaced container or nonzero exit, stop and preserve the refusal. No sudo/alternate account/command/encoded-payload retry. Tool acceptance is unverified until formal review.
Archive only aggregate final JSON. Do not archive child output, tags, nonce, original environment or debug logs. Close only the executing operator's own session.

Matching shared inputs is necessary only; it does not verify derived CHRO authentication, route availability, employee/recipient mapping, outbox/cutover semantics, duplicate handling, device receipt or restore. Keep those gates explicitly pending.
